verdict.rationale: Insomnia has an import/export docs page listing open formats such as Postman v2.x, HAR, OpenAPI 3.x, Swagger, WSDL and cURL, plus its own Insomnia JSON v4 and YAML v5 formats. Git Sync keeps project data in your own third-party Git repo, not hosted by Insomnia, and projects can be converted to Local Vault, which together make leaving plausible. However, the evidence does not clearly say which of those formats are export targets versus import-only, nor that a single export captures all data (environments, tests, mocks, cookies). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of export formats and a full-account or bulk export, coverage of non-collection data such as mocks and cloud-synced items, and independent hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.
